test.create_query: CREATE VIEW pd_gen AS SELECT number AS id, intHash64(number) % 50000000 AS user_id, toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + intDiv(number, 100) AS event_time, multiIf(number % 64 = 0, '', number % 64 = 1, 'zzzz', number % 1000 = 0 AND number % 500000 < 100000, 'rare', concat('cat_', toString(number % 500))) AS category, concat('https://example.com/', toString(intHash64(number % 25000000) % 20000000), '/page?x=', toString((number % 25000000) % 977)) AS url, toDecimal64(intHash32(number) % 1000000, 2) AS price, if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, tuple(toUInt32(number % 100000), concat('v', toString(number % 3000))))::Nullable(Tuple(a UInt32, b String)) AS t, map(concat('k', toString(number % 7)), number % 1000, concat('k', toString(number % 11 + 7)), number % 333) AS m FROM numbers(100000000)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet', Parquet) SELECT * FROM pd_gen SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 100000, preferred_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_block_size = 100000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, output_format_parquet_max_dictionary_size = 262144, output_format_parquet_data_page_size = 65536, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
SELECT throwIf(num_rows != 100000000 OR num_row_groups != 1000 OR arrayExists(r -> r.3 != 100000, row_groups)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet', ParquetMetadata)
SELECT throwIf(arrayExists(r -> arrayFirst(c -> c.1 = 'url', r.6).7 <= 0, row_groups)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet', ParquetMetadata)

SELECT throwIf(arrayFirst(c -> c.1 = 'category', columns).11 != ['PLAIN', 'RLE_DICTIONARY'] OR arrayFirst(c -> c.1 = 'id', columns).11 != ['PLAIN']) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet', ParquetMetadata)

SELECT throwIf(sum(length(url)) != (SELECT sum(length(url)) FROM pd_gen WHERE id BETWEEN 40000000 AND 59999999)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE id BETWEEN 40000000 AND 59999999 SETTINGS input_format_parquet_filter_push_down = {on}, input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = 0, log_comment = 'parquet_pushdown_long.minmax.{on}'

SELECT throwIf(sum(length(url)) != (SELECT sum(length(url)) FROM pd_gen WHERE id IN (SELECT number * 16000 + 12345 FROM numbers(6250)))) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE id IN (SELECT number * 16000 + 12345 FROM numbers(6250)) SETTINGS input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = {on}, input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0, log_comment = 'parquet_pushdown_long.page.{on}'

SELECT throwIf(count() != (SELECT count() FROM pd_gen WHERE url IN (SELECT concat('https://example.com/', toString(intHash64(n) % 20000000), '/page?x=', toString(n % 977)) FROM (SELECT number * 500003 AS n FROM numbers(50))))) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE url IN (SELECT concat('https://example.com/', toString(intHash64(n) % 20000000), '/page?x=', toString(n % 977)) FROM (SELECT number * 500003 AS n FROM numbers(50))) SETTINGS input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = {on}, log_comment = 'parquet_pushdown_long.bloom.{on}'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(url, ifNull(toString(t), ''), m))) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(url, ifNull(toString(t), ''), m)) FROM pd_gen WHERE category = 'rare')) FROM (SELECT url, t, m FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE category = 'rare') SETTINGS input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_dictionary_filter_push_down = {dict_limit}, log_comment = 'parquet_pushdown_long.dict.{dict_limit}'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(url, ifNull(toString(t), ''), m))) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(url, ifNull(toString(t), ''), m)) FROM pd_gen WHERE category = 'cat_7')) FROM (SELECT url, t, m FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE category = 'cat_7') SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere = {on}, log_comment = 'parquet_pushdown_long.prewhere.{on}'
SELECT throwIf(ifNull((sum(t.a), countIf(t IS NULL), sum(m['k3'])) != (SELECT sum(t.a), countIf(t IS NULL), sum(m['k3']) FROM pd_gen), 1)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet')

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(id, user_id, toDateTime(event_time), category, url, price, ifNull(toString(t), ''), m))) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(id, user_id, event_time, category, url, price, ifNull(toString(t), ''), m)) FROM pd_gen)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet')

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((m, n, ok)) != [('bloom', 2, 1), ('dict', 2, 1), ('minmax', 2, 1), ('page', 2, 1), ('prewhere', 2, 1)]) FROM ( SELECT splitByChar('.', log_comment)[2] AS m, count() AS n, if(m = 'prewhere', sumIf(ProfileEvents['ParquetRowsFilterExpression'], on) > 0 AND sumIf(ProfileEvents['ParquetRowsFilterExpression'], NOT on) = 0, sumIf(ProfileEvents['ParquetReadPages'], on) < sumIf(ProfileEvents['ParquetReadPages'], NOT on)) AS ok FROM ( SELECT log_comment, splitByChar('.', log_comment)[3] != '0' AS on, ProfileEvents FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment LIKE 'parquet_pushdown_long.%' AND event_time >= (SELECT metadata_modification_time FROM system.tables WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND name = 'pd_gen') ) GROUP BY m ORDER BY m )
test.query: SELECT sum(length(url)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE id BETWEEN 40000000 AND 59999999 SETTINGS input_format_parquet_filter_push_down = {on}, input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = 0

SELECT sum(length(url)) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE id IN (SELECT number * 16000 + 12345 FROM numbers(6250)) SETTINGS input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = {on}, input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0

SELECT count() FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE url IN (SELECT concat('https://example.com/', toString(intHash64(n) % 20000000), '/page?x=', toString(n % 977)) FROM (SELECT number * 500003 AS n FROM numbers(50))) SETTINGS input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = {on}

SELECT url, t, m FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE category = 'rare' FORMAT Null SETTINGS input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_dictionary_filter_push_down = {dict_limit}
SELECT url, t, m FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet') WHERE category = 'cat_7' FORMAT Null SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere = {on}
SELECT sum(t.a), countIf(t IS NULL) FROM file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet')
test.drop_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('parquet_pushdown_long/pd.parquet', RawBLOB) SELECT '' SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pd_gen SYNC
